original_snippet:
if order.status == "cancelled":            # ← the enforcement point
        raise OrderCancelledError(order.id)
description: Remove the cancelled-order guard from ship_order
expected_violation: A cancelled order is shipped instead of rejected
violation_scenario: ship_order(Order(id='C1', status='cancelled', quantity=1)) returns an order with status 'shipped' and raises nothing.
rationale: Deleting the two guard lines is the smallest plausible change that lets a cancelled order ship.
